concretefindings: Read all prose and nine exact cited headlines. CNBC n0373 establishes institutional dip buying, not a stated longer holding horizon; removed that unsupported attribution. BTC58719.48USD,-3.65% matches Aug11 completed UTC card.

Mox n1327 supports commenced ETF access versus planned direct crypto trading; prose preserves actual/plan distinction. Motley Fool n0380 supplies wealth-framing attention, without invented posts or engagement counts.

VanEck n1325 is explicitly treated as conditional valuation scenarios, without importing model targets or asserting adoption outcome. Reuters n0365 concerns a campaign stockpile proposal; election and implementation remain pending.

Investopedia n0760 supports TSMC July sales growth45% and AI demand; no invented profit or cash-flow figure. CBS n1363 supports DJT quarterly revenue decline30%, NBC Los Angeles n1362 supports quarterly loss; no election outcome admitted.

Reuters n0734 supports Expedia positive reaction/profit beat versus demand warning. All reported company outcomes predate Aug12 midnight. General analogy, ETF trading-hours/direct-custody risk and demand/valuation invalidations are stated as mechanics, not named historical episodes.
